svg.title: Coupling NEST to a peer process through the NCP local SDK and MUSIC
svg.desc: Preregistered benchmark of 13 October 2026 on an Apple MacBook Pro with an M4 Max chip and 128 GB of memory: NEST 3.10.0, 1,000 neurons, one thread, 2 s of biological time per run, five shuffled rounds. Panel a: median wall time per run for six arms at exchange intervals of 1, 2, 5 and 10 ms; MUSIC lies on top of NEST alone. Panel b: median paired difference per exchange: the NCP exchange adds about 1.5 ms, returning spikes adds about 20 microseconds per spike, Python chunking adds 0.55 to 0.59 ms, and MUSIC adds 13 to 113 microseconds per exchange, about 25 ms per run.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
